Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Shalini - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan sings a song.]

Ayaan: "That's easy."

[Ayaan hugs Mother tightly.]

Shalini: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan points at the sky.]

Ayaan: "Yes, all right."

[Ayaan scratches his head.]

Ayaan (softly): "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan whispers something to Mother.]

Ayaan: "Let's see."

[Ayaan takes the bag from Mother.]

Ayaan: "I really enjoyed today."
